notablePrerequisites:
Briar Hydra does not have summoning sickness.
You control a land of each basic land type.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Briar Hydra.
description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Briar Hydra.
Briar Hydra triggers, putting five +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one additional turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
